statute_note: Principal source: the Inland Revenue Department PDF of the Stamp Duty Act, No. 43 of 1982 (registry SRC034, 55 pp. including the rates schedule, text layer, two-column departmental layout). It prints no amendment-chain header; amending instruments appear as bare N/YEAR markers in the margin (71/1988 x23, 27/1991 x10, 29/1993 x13, 63/1993 x6, 6/1996 x2, 38/1996 x1, 25/1999 x3, 27/2000 x3, plus three misprints). Other sources inspected: the LankaLaw HTML edition (statutes/HTML/43-1982-stamp-duty-act.html, 75 sections, chain header “71 of 1988 … 27 of 2000 11 of 2002 12 of 2006”, 42 inline markers none later than 27 of 2000); eight held amending Acts under amendments/incoming (title pages read: 27/1991, 29/1993, 63/1993, 6/1996 and 38/1996 are scans with no text layer; 25/1999, 27/2000 and 12/2006 have Government Printer text layers) with their LankaLaw HTML and canonical-amendments trees; and the two files RUBRIK pairs with this Act from the curriculum, 10-2008 (amends Act No. 12 of 2006) and 23-2018 (Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) Act), both excluded. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 27 of 2000, the latest instrument the margin markers demonstrate; the words 2002 and 2006 do not occur in the file outside Gazette dates, so the print does not incorporate 11 of 2002 or 12 of 2006. Act No. 12 of 2006 was read in full: it does not amend the text of this Act (its section 13 overrides inconsistent provisions on imposition and exemptions; section 15 repeals Part III of the Finance Act, No. 11 of 2002), so nothing was applied to the tree and the instrument is recorded as held_but_not_applied. Review performed in this pass: the accepted tree (byte-identical to the canonical parse) was re-read against the print at every section whose heading was empty, marker-only or disagreed with the HTML edition; all 75 headings were compared with the HTML edition parsed by build_canonical_statutes.parse. The print floats its marginal notes above the provision they belong to, so the parser had attached notes to the preceding section and left eight sections headingless; 19 headings were corrected by hand (13, 20, 21, 29, 30, 32-44, 68), 14 marker prefixes were moved out of headings into margin_markers, and the damaged readings are kept in heading_raw. Section 34's note is not printed in the IRD copy and comes from the HTML alone. No body text was changed; the earlier five-lens subagent review (two rounds, converged) and the six residues in canonical-overrides.json stand. Structural weaknesses carried over and documented in the tree's quality_flags: rates schedule excluded (about 11% of the print), section 56's numbered list flattened, section 14(1)(a)/(b) fused, long-title note bleed, section 49 external reference misread as internal, section 40(10) wrap loss, and the bare-marker format unresolved to operations. Missing sources: Act No. 71 of 1988 (the heaviest amending instrument) and the Finance Act, No. 11 of 2002 are not held. Unresolved: whether 11 of 2002 altered the text of this Act; the three misprinted markers (61/1996, 71/1998, 24/1993). The registry title “Stamp Duty Act” matches section 1. Lawyer verification: none. Everything here is pipeline output and remains lawyer-unverified.

baseline.publisher_caveat: Departmental consolidation in a two-column layout with bare N/YEAR margin markers and no chain header; not a Government Printer text. The registry row calls it the “Official Inland Revenue Department PDF”.
baseline.cutoff_evidence: No chain header is printed. The latest instrument the margin markers demonstrate is 27/2000, printed three times: beside section 13(2) (“(2) Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this section- / 27/2000 / i) any person making payments to one hundred employees or more…”), beside exemption item 28 (“27/2000  28) a forward contract between a buyer and a seller…”) and beside 13(2)(ii) (“27/2000  of corporeal movables, application made for a letter of credit”). The words “2002” and “2006” do not occur in the file outside Gazette references dated 2001 in the rates schedule. The LankaLaw HTML chain header goes on to “11 of 2002 12 of 2006” but neither source carries an inline marker for either, so the print's text is not shown to postdate 27 of 2000.

amendment_reconciliation.title: Finance Act, No. 11 of 2002 (title inferred from Act No. 12 of 2006 s.15, which repeals its Part III; no copy held)
amendment_reconciliation.reason: Named in the LankaLaw HTML chain header only. Neither the IRD print nor the HTML carries an inline marker for it, and the file has no “2002” outside Gazette dates. Its Part III (sections 15 to 18) governed stamp duty from 1 May 2002 and was repealed by Act No. 12 of 2006 s.15. Not held; effect on the text of this Act, if any, cannot be established from disk.

amendment_reconciliation.title: STAMP DUTY (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 12 OF 2006 [Certified on 31st March, 2006]; “AN ACT TO PTOVIDE FOR THE RE-IMPOSITION OF STAMP DUTY ; TO PROVIDE FOR THE REPEAL OR PART III OF THE FINANCE ACT, NO. 11 OF 2002 ; …”
amendment_reconciliation.reason: Held as Government Printer text (text layer) and LankaLaw HTML (16 sections, complete), both read in full. The IRD baseline predates it (no marker, no “2006” in the file). Its operative text contains no amending operation on the words of the Stamp Duty Act: section 13 provides that the 1982 Act's provisions on the imposition of stamp duty (other than for transfers of immovable property, transfers of motor vehicles and documents filed in Court), exemptions and any other provision “shall, in so far as the same are inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, have no operation”, and section 15 repeals Part III of the Finance Act, No. 11 of 2002. An override of operation is not a textual substitution, insertion or repeal that can be applied to a node, so nothing was applied; the relationship is recorded here and in the tree's amendments list. The canonical tree data/processed/canonical-amendments/12-2006.json (from the HTML) likewise carries zero amendment_instructions.
